segments.text: proposition 1 IMages ſhould not be placed in temples.
proposition 2 In that men take pleaſure of imitation, it commeth hereof, that they are made according to the image of God.
proposition 3 In the primitiue church, before the Goſpell was publikelie receiued, the profeſſours of prophane authours taught with great danger of the hearers: but at this daie it is not ſo.
